about_short_description.short_description: Presenter notes for live SaaS demos

product.name: Presenter Notes Browser Extension
product.description: A browser extension that provides synchronized, contextually relevant talking points during live SaaS demos to assist presenters in delivering consistent and informed presentations.

product.name: Google Calendar Integration
product.description: An integration that connects Demo Gorilla with Google Calendar to track meeting participants, timing, and agenda notes automatically during demos.

product.name: User Account Configuration and Management
product.description: Tools and processes for setting up, managing, and maintaining user accounts within Demo Gorilla, including permissions and access control.

product.name: Content Management for Demo Preparation
product.description: A system to create, organize, and manage demo content such as talking points, talk tracks, tags, and collections to tailor demos to specific audiences and scenarios.

product.name: Session Tracking and Review Requests
product.description: Features to monitor demo sessions, track notes and learnings, and submit content review requests to maintain up-to-date and accurate demo materials.

product.name: Sales Coaching Services
product.description: Personalized coaching to improve demo effectiveness, including script review, content assistance, and actionable feedback.
